item.text:
Final pass complete; the audit budget is now exhausted. Report: [report.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-08_13-11-14-hashicorp_raft-baseline/work/report.md).

**End-of-budget confirmation:** re-ran the headline reproduction (`-count=4` over `ProtocolVersion_Upgrade_1_2`, `_2_3`, and `HasExistingState`; `audit/final-confirm.log`) — **2 of 12 failed**, both upgrade tests, both with the `testing.go:705 peer mismatch` signature. Reproducible on demand.

**Deliverable summary**

- **Artifact identity:** byte-for-byte identical to upstream `hashicorp/raft` v1.7.3 (the `source_identity` tag hash); no planted mutation exists. Any defect is pre-existing upstream.
- **Finding 1 (concrete, reproduced):** `(*cluster).EnsureSamePeers` (`testing.go:692-715`) captures `c.rafts[0]`'s configuration once and never refreshes it across the retry loop, so an early read of a not-yet-converged node permanently poisons the comparison and fails the test after `longstopTimeout`. Observed victims `ProtocolVersion_Upgrade_1_2`, `_2_3`, `HasExistingState`; 10 tests call the helper. Root cause isolated (nodes converge in ~20 ms; the helper is at fault) and the one-line re-read fix verified 20/20.
- **Secondary, source-based only:** `EnsureLeader` (`testing.go:582-604`) is the only assertion helper without a retry loop.
- **No defect found in the core consensus/agreement logic,** supported by executed negative evidence: full non-network suite clean under `-race`; committed-entry churn soak 2/2 with no losses; snapshot region 50/50 under `-race`; `go build`/`go vet` clean.
- **Open/uncovered:** network transport and the nested `fuzzy`/`raft-compat` modules (cannot build/run offline), plus disk-backed/restart soak.

All reproduction artifacts are preserved under `work/audit/` (14 logs) plus the diagnostic-only `audit_diag_test.go`; `source/` was never modified.
